note: City of Morris campground on the pool of the Pomme de Terre River above the Morris dam; the waterfront-tagged sites 9-18 line the west side of the west loop, facing the water. Spray park, disc golf, a dock, canoeing, fishing and a playground. After October 15 the water supply depends on the weather and the city's discretion (Campspot). --Claude
summary: City page + Campspot read: $30 (+$5 booking fee) confirmed; 28 RV sites (water + 30/50 A, 13 pull-throughs) + 6 tent; open on Campspot for mid-November. Lakeview kept after a hard check - the operator's 10 'Waterfront' sites (9-18) sit ~20-27 m from the water across mowed grass with a thin brushy bank fringe: lakefront lead. Google 4.6/108.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakeview, checked hard - KEPT, with a lakefront lead): Campspot sells two 'Waterfront' types - 30 Amp Waterfront / Back-In (sites 10, 11, 13, 16) and 50 Amp Waterfront/Back-in (09, 12, 14, 15, 17, 18), all bookable by the night and 35-60 ft. The operator's map puts them in a row along the west edge of the west loop. On Esri imagery the RVs on that edge (about 45.5733,-95.8826 to 45.5726,-95.8831) sit roughly 20-27 m from the water across open mowed grass; a narrow, fairly continuous strip of brush and small trees lines the bank, thicker at the south end. The open lawn alone puts the floor at lakeview. Lakefront would need the bank fringe shown not to screen the water (no type photos on Campspot). Distances are imagery estimates; Overpass was down.

Water body: the Campspot map labels the water 'Pomme De Terre River', and a dam sits just south of County Hwy 10. The campground is on the upstream pool, a wide impoundment (several hundred metres across on imagery), at pool level - not below the dam. 'lake' values fit the pool, but the reviewer may prefer river values; the stored note's 'Pomme de Terre Lake' is not a name the city or Campspot uses (note reworded).

Pin: stored 45.57450,-95.87950 is at the park's day-use buildings, ~250 m north-east of the RV loops (about 45.5730,-95.8815 on imagery); Google's pin is 45.57386,-95.87955. Borderline; move to 45.5730,-95.8815 if desired.
Fees confirmed: Campspot $35 a night on 2026-11-17 = the city's $30 RV rate plus the $5 booking fee already stored; the tent type quotes $30 ($25 + $5).
Phone 320-589-3141 confirmed (city page and Google Maps). Google Maps: 4.6 stars, 108 reviews.

Season: no dates posted by the city; Campspot sells November nights and says that after October 15 water depends on weather and the city's discretion ('no discounts and no free cancellations'); no season written.
Note cleaned: dropped 'water and electric sites, tent sites, restrooms' (fields hold them) and replaced 'Pomme de Terre Lake'.
Showers (stored, derived from old note prose): neither the city page nor Campspot mentions showers or restrooms; left as stored, unconfirmed.
